meta.title: How to choose an SKO lid for canning
meta.description: Five signs of a good SKO lid: stiffening ribs, sealing ring, weight, food-grade lacquer inside and enamel colour. A buyer's guide.

hero.title: How to choose an SKO lid
hero.lead: Five signs that show a good lid at a glance. Check them before you take a batch.

ribs.d: The ribs keep the lid's shape during seaming and storage. Look at the profile: it should be even and crisp.

ring.d: The rubber should be food grade, elastic and free of cracks. The ring sits evenly and does not rattle.

weight.d: Weigh the lid together with its ring. We will give you the exact weight guide on request.

lacquer.d: The inner coating matters more than the outer: it touches the food.

colour.d: A silver or pearl colour inside means food enamel.

rule.title: The main rule of canning
rule.text: Sterility. A lid is only as good as the clean jar and correct processing it goes with.
